primary.title: Worth Wandering: Low-tech Magazine
primary.summary: A magazine about questioning technological progress, served from a tiny computer on a balcony in Barcelona that occasionally disappears from the internet because the sun stopped cooperating.

primary.title: Rediscovering Long-Form Email
primary.summary: From humble beginnings in eLearning, I have somehow spent the majority of my career thus far in or around email. Not to flex, but I am an email expert. Cold, hot, and everything in between. I'm one of very few people on the planet that can say they've personally been responsible for sending 10,000,000 emails a day.
